festivals.name: New Year's Day
festivals.description: The first day of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

festivals.name: National Youth Day
festivals.description: Commemorates the birthday of Swami Vivekananda.

festivals.name: Lohri
festivals.description: A popular winter Punjabi folk festival celebrated primarily by Sikhs and Hindus from the Punjab region.

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti / Pongal
festivals.description: A harvest festival dedicated to the Sun God, Surya.

festivals.name: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Jayanti
festivals.description: The birthday of a prominent Indian freedom fighter.

festivals.name: Republic Day
festivals.description: Honours the date on which the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950.

festivals.name: Martyrs' Day
festivals.description: Marks the assassination of Mahatma Gandhi in 1948.

festivals.name: Vasant Panchami
festivals.description: A festival that marks the preparation for the arrival of spring.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri
festivals.description: A major festival in Hinduism, celebrating the night of Shiva.

festivals.name: Holi
festivals.description: A popular ancient Hindu festival, also known as the 'Festival of Colors'.

festivals.name: Good Friday
festivals.description: A Christian holiday commemorating the crucifixion of Jesus and his death at Calvary.

festivals.name: Easter
festivals.description: A Christian festival and cultural holiday commemorating the resurrection of Jesus from the dead.

festivals.name: Eid al-Fitr
festivals.description: An important religious holiday celebrated by Muslims worldwide that marks the end of Ramadan.

festivals.name: Vaisakhi
festivals.description: A historical and religious festival in Sikhism and Hinduism.

festivals.name: Ambedkar Jayanti
festivals.description: Commemorates the birth of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, the architect of the Indian Constitution.

festivals.name: Rama Navami
festivals.description: A Hindu festival that celebrates the birthday of Rama, the seventh avatar of the deity Vishnu.

festivals.name: Mahavir Jayanti
festivals.description: Celebrates the birth of Mahavira, the twenty-fourth and last Tirthankara.

festivals.name: Labour Day
festivals.description: An annual holiday to celebrate the achievements of workers.

festivals.name: Buddha Purnima
festivals.description: Commemorates the birth, enlightenment, and death of Gautama Buddha.

festivals.name: Eid al-Adha
festivals.description: The latter of the two official holidays celebrated within Islam.

festivals.name: Rath Yatra
festivals.description: A Hindu festival associated with Lord Jagannath held at Puri in the state of Odisha, India.

festivals.name: Muharram
festivals.description: The first month of the Islamic calendar and a period of mourning for Shia Muslims.

festivals.name: Independence Day
festivals.description: Commemorates India's independence from the United Kingdom in 1947.

festivals.name: Raksha Bandhan
festivals.description: A festival that celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters.

festivals.name: Janmashtami
festivals.description: Celebrates the birth of Krishna, the eighth avatar of Vishnu.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.description: A festival honoring the elephant-headed god Ganesha.

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.description: A major annual harvest festival celebrated in the Indian state of Kerala.

festivals.name: Milad un-Nabi (Eid-e-Milad)
festivals.description: Commemorates the birth of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.

festivals.name: Gandhi Jayanti
festivals.description: Celebrates the birthday of Mahatma Gandhi, the 'Father of the Nation'.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.description: A nine-night Hindu festival, celebrated in the autumn.

festivals.name: Dussehra
festivals.description: A major Hindu festival celebrated at the end of Navratri every year.

festivals.name: Diwali
festivals.description: The festival of lights, one of the major festivals celebrated by Hindus, Jains, and Sikhs.

festivals.name: Guru Nanak Jayanti
festivals.description: Celebrates the birth of the first Sikh Guru, Guru Nanak.

festivals.name: Christmas
festivals.description: An annual festival commemorating the birth of Jesus Christ.
